description.p: spotDL GNOME is a native GTK4 / libadwaita desktop app for Linux that finds songs from your Spotify tracks, albums and playlists and downloads matching audio from YouTube, together with album art, lyrics and metadata.

ul.li: Download tracks, albums and playlists by pasting a Spotify link
Automatic backup sources (YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp) when a song fails
Per-song progress, error reasons and a retry button
Choose output format (MP3, FLAC, Opus, M4A, OGG, WAV) and bitrate

description.p: It is built on the spotDL command line engine. FFmpeg and Deno are bundled, so no additional dependencies are required.
Initial release: native GTK4 / libadwaita desktop GUI packaged as a Flatpak.
